Use when a task splits into many independent or staged pieces of agent work (fan out over files, modules, bugs, or review angles, then aggregate), or when the user asks for a workflow. Don't use for a single delegated task (use a subagent) or for legacy workflow files (see migrate-workflows).

availableCommands.name: swarm

Use when the work splits into pieces that can be done at the same time, or when a second pair of eyes should check the first pair's work.

update.title: Subagent File Writing and Tool Reporting

content.text: Delegating file writing and tool enumeration tasks requires spawning a dedicated subagent. Passing the execution context to a child instance ensures access to the required file-writing capabilities and tool definition schemas.

Evaluating `self` versus custom subagent definitions for capability inheritance. The `self` configuration preserves the parent context and enables write permissions, but verifying workspace path inheritance ensures files are placed correctly.
